name: DTE Energy
description: DTE Energy is a Michigan holding company whose regulated utilities (DTE Electric, about 2.3 million customers in southeastern Michigan, and DTE Gas, about 1.4 million customers in Michigan) produce nearly all of its earnings: the Electric and Gas segments earned 99% of 2025 net income before corporate costs. Rates are set by the Michigan Public Service Commission with authorised ROEs of 9.9% (electric) and 9.8% (gas), and pending cases ask for 10.75% and 10.25%. It also runs DTE Vantage (on-site industrial energy services and carbon capture development) and an Energy Trading segment that books $6.5 billion of revenue (41% of the consolidated total) but only $123 million of earnings, because most of that revenue is gross wholesale gas and power trading flow rather than margin.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Multi-Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

employees.note: Approximately 9,650 employees, about 4,850 represented by unions; DTE Electric about 4,400 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Electric (DTE Electric)
businessLines.how: Customers pay MPSC-approved electric rates monthly; fuel and purchased power are adjusted through a cost-recovery mechanism, and base rates are set to earn the authorised 9.9% ROE on rate base.
businessLines.description: Generation, purchase, distribution and sale of electricity to about 2.3 million customers in southeastern Michigan; 51,769 GWh sold in 2025 (residential $3,144M, commercial $2,195M, industrial $652M, other $944M).

revenue.note: Total electric operating revenues (FY2024 $6,293M, FY2023 $5,818M); consolidated operating revenues $15,814M

businessLines.revenueNote: Total electric operating revenues (FY2024 $6,293M, FY2023 $5,818M); consolidated operating revenues $15,814M

operatingProfit.note: Segment net income attributable to DTE Energy (FY2024 $1,072M, FY2023 $772M)

businessLines.name: Gas (DTE Gas)
businessLines.how: Regulated gas delivery, storage and transportation charges, with the cost of gas passed through a gas cost recovery mechanism.
businessLines.description: Purchase, storage, transportation, distribution and sale of natural gas to about 1.4 million customers in Michigan (gas sales $1,521M, end-user transportation $255M, intermediate transportation $87M, other $189M).

operatingProfit.note: Segment net income attributable to DTE Energy (FY2024 $257M, FY2023 $294M)

businessLines.name: DTE Vantage
businessLines.how: Industrial customers pay under long-term contracts and leases for utility-type services delivered from assets on or near their sites.
businessLines.description: On-site energy (power generation, steam, chilled water, wastewater treatment and compressed air at or near industrial customers' premises in automotive, airport, chemical and other industries) and carbon capture and sequestration projects in development.

revenue.note: FY2024 $753M, FY2023 $809M; includes $61M of lease revenue

businessLines.name: Energy Trading
businessLines.how: Buys and sells wholesale power and gas and earns the trading margin; reported revenue is gross of purchases, so earnings are a small fraction of revenue.
